meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用七个分析维度研究公司、行业或竞品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要结构化商业情报
copy.tagline_en: Research companies, industries, or competitors with seven analytical lenses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured business intelligence before product decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过七个分析视角（财务、市场、产品、竞争、趋势、PM 影响、战略信号）研究公司、行业或竞争对手，输出结构化报告，供下游技能生成 battlecard、SWOT 等。
howto.when: 当你要求研究某家公司、行业或竞争对手，或说“发现我的竞争对手”时触发。也支持输入网址。

say.text: 研究一下特斯拉的竞争对手
给我一份临床数据管理行业的分析
say.note: Claude 会按行业入口输出 11 个板块的结构化报告。

say.text: 对比 Emerson、Honeywell 和 Parker Hannifin
say.note: Claude 会为每家公司输出报告，并增加跨公司对比章节。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude researches a company, industry, or competitor set using seven analytical lenses (financial, market, product, competitive, trends, PM implications, strategic signals) and produces a structured report for downstream skills like battlecards or SWOT.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to research a company, industry, or competitor set, or say 'discover my competitors.' Also works with a URL.

say_en.text: Give me an analysis of the clinical data management industry.
say_en.note: Claude outputs an 11-section structured report for the industry entry point.

say_en.text: Compare Emerson, Honeywell, and Parker Hannifin.
say_en.note: Claude produces individual reports plus a cross-company comparison section.
